title: separate VPN and wifi connections in networkmanager applet
line: The Networks widget now lists VPN connections in their own "VPN" section, below the Wi-Fi and wired networks.
explanation: The Networks widget groups connections only by state (Connected / Available), so every saved VPN and WireGuard connection was sorted into the Available list among Wi-Fi and wired networks. With several VPNs the Wi-Fi networks got pushed down, and VPN rows moved around whenever the Wi-Fi scan changed. The applet's proxy model now sorts inactive VPN/WireGuard connections after all other available networks and gives them their own "VPN" section header; active VPNs stay under Connected.

commits.message:
applet: show available VPN connections in their own section

VPN and WireGuard connections were mixed into the Available section
together with Wi-Fi and wired networks, sorted among them. They are now
listed after the other networks under their own VPN section header.

BUG: 435475

media.caption: Master: four VPNs and a WireGuard tunnel sit in Available between HomeNet and the other Wi-Fi networks, which are pushed out of view
With the fix: Wi-Fi networks stay together under Available, VPNs are listed below under their own VPN header
